title: kbtools.py ranks kbmon.py above querylog.py for the plural need query logs, since the several-word name rule joins the need's raw words
goal: kbtools.py NEED puts querylog.py first for the need query logs as for query log: a name of several words matches the words of a need whatever their endings

run:
import json
import subprocess
import sys

r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/kbtools.py', 'query logs', '--json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
first = json.loads(r.stdout)['entries'][0]['tool'] if r.returncode == 0 else None
print('first entry for query logs:', first)
sys.exit(0 if first == 'querylog.py' else 1)
